'''Beast vault Z-26''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] vault located in [[The Tomb]] section of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ondorru]] confronted [[Conrad Gall]] and the [[Major/Legends|Major]] of [[Havoc Squad]].
